usdRate.note: NZD 1 = USD 0.5629, so about NZD 1.78 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 1.72.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics (Stats NZ CPI, September 2026 quarter)
inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI 3.7% to the September 2026 quarter (4.1% to June); secondary source because the Stats NZ release page renders without figures.

inflation_projection.sourceName: RBNZ 1-3% target (2% midpoint); CPI 3.7% in Q3 2026, 2.8% in 2025 (World Bank)
inflation_projection.note: The 1-3% target is credible over the long run but inflation has run above the midpoint, so 2.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics (RBNZ Official Cash Rate decision)
policy_rate.note: OCR held at 2.75% on 28 October 2026 (4-3 vote); secondary source because rbnz.govt.nz refused automated access. The market expects a hike at the next meeting.

savings_account_rate.sourceName: interest.co.nz (financial news site) savings (call) account rate table
savings_account_rate.note: Ordinary savings/call accounts at the large banks pay about 0.05-0.25% (online and bonus saver accounts 0.5-2.2%); 0.15% used. Read 31 October 2026. Source is a financial news site's rate table (RBNZ retail rate tables refused automated access).

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: interest.co.nz (financial news site) term deposit rate table (under 1 year)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Major banks' 3-month rates 2.85-3.05%; midpoint used. Table date not shown; read 31 October 2026. Source is a financial news site's rate table (RBNZ retail rate tables refused automated access).

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: interest.co.nz (financial news site) term deposit rate table (1-5 years)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Major banks' 1-year rates 4.00-4.05%; 5-year 4.70-5.00%. Table date not shown; read 31 October 2026. Source is a financial news site's rate table (RBNZ retail rate tables refused automated access).

dps_rate.note: New Zealand banks do not offer a monthly recurring deposit (DPS-style) product; regular saving is done through savings accounts and KiwiSaver.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Trading Economics shows an RBNZ deposit rate series at 4.79% for September 2026, which looks like a term-deposit series rather than an all-deposit average.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Kiwi Bonds (retail government bonds, 6 months to 4 years) exist, but the Debt Management site refused automated access and no current rate was found elsewhere.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, New Zealand 3-month bill yield
tbill_91d_rate.note: Secondary source; RBNZ wholesale rate tables refused automated access. 3.18% on 3 November 2026.

tbond_5y_rate.note: RBNZ table B2 and the NZDM site refused automated access and no 5-year government bond yield was found on secondary sources read (the 2-year was 3.75% and the 10-year 4.82% on 30 Oct 2026).

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, New Zealand 10-year government bond yield

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, New Zealand personal income tax rates
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest is taxed at the saver's marginal rate (10.5%, 17.5%, 30%, 33% or 39%) through resident withholding tax; 30% (income NZD 53,501-78,100) used as the typical earner rate.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, New Zealand personal income tax rates
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Kiwi Bond interest is ordinary taxable interest at the marginal rate; 30% used as the typical rate.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Wikipedia, Deposit insurance (New Zealand Depositor Compensation Scheme)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: Depositor Compensation Scheme under the Deposit Takers Act 2023: NZD 100,000 per depositor per licensed deposit taker from 1 July 2025; secondary source because rbnz.govt.nz refused automated access.

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: interest.co.nz (financial news site) credit card rate table
credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap; 20.95% is the most common standard purchase rate at major banks (low-rate cards 12.9-13.9%). Source is a financial news site's rate table (RBNZ retail rate tables refused automated access).

equity_return_low.sourceName: NZX 50 gross index 13,797 (30 Oct 2026), up 1.8% in a year
equity_return_low.note: Low case after a weak few years for the NZX 50, roughly the after-tax term deposit rate plus a small premium.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Major-bank 1-year term deposit 4.0% less 30% RWT = 2.8%; NZX 50 gross index
equity_return_base.note: After-tax safe rate of 2.8% plus a 3.7-point premium, kept under 4 points because the NZX 50 has been flat recently.

equity_return_high.sourceName: NZX 50 gross index long-run record (base 1,880.85 in Dec 2000 to 13,797 in Oct 2026)
equity_return_high.note: High case near the NZX 50 gross index's roughly 8% a year since 2000.

gold_return_low.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (NZD per USD 1.72 in 2025); NZD/USD 0.563 on 30 Oct 2026
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stable or stronger New Zealand dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (NZD per USD 1.72 in 2025); NZD/USD 0.563 on 30 Oct 2026
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% plus about 1% a year of NZD weakness against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF (NZD per USD 1.72 in 2025); NZD/USD 0.563 on 30 Oct 2026
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker NZD.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: rolling short term deposits after 30% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: 1-year term deposits after 30% resident withholding tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in 5-year term deposits after tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry-wide life claim settlement ratio published by the RBNZ, FMA or the Financial Services Council was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life is widely sold in New Zealand, but no published per-1,000 premium table by age was found; insurers quote individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical private hospital bill was found; public hospital care is free for residents.

health_premium_table.note: NZ private health insurance is priced per plan with annual limits rather than per sum insured, and no age-banded premium table was found.

oop_health_share.note: 2024 figure, the latest World Bank year (older than 2025); public hospital care is free for residents.

goal_inflation_health.note: The Stats NZ health group figure could not be read, so we plan with the headline projection plus one point for private medical costs.

goal_inflation_education.note: The Stats NZ education group figure could not be read, so we plan with the headline projection plus one point for fees.

life_expectancy.note: 2024 figure, the latest World Bank year (older than 2025). Men 80.4, women 83.7; UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 82.5 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant projection for 2026 (mid-year); totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (the page publishes a total only at 65).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 27.3 (2025, World Bank), 36.7 (2040) and 46.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/new-zealand/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Work and Income, NZ Super eligibility
retirement_age_default.note: NZ Super is paid from 65 to men and women, including people born after 1975 under current law (the Work and Income eligibility page shows no legislated change to the age); there is no compulsory retirement age.

retirement_age_government.note: No compulsory retirement age for public servants (only judges retire at 70); 65 is the normal retirement age because NZ Super starts then. Secondary source.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: short term deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: laddered 5-year term deposits after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Major-bank 1-year term deposit 4.0% less 30% RWT = 2.8%; NZX 50 gross index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced KiwiSaver-style mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Major-bank 1-year term deposit 4.0% less 30% RWT = 2.8%; NZX 50 gross index
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 6.5% and half fixed income at about 3.5% pre-tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Major-bank 1-year term deposit 4.0% less 30% RWT = 2.8%; NZX 50 gross index
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Work and Income, benefit rates from 1 April 2026 (NZ Superannuation)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: NZ Super, single living alone, NZD 647.37 a week gross (555.15 net at tax code M) = about 2,805 a month gross (x52/12); people in a couple get 492.14 a week each gross. Paid fortnightly.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: Work and Income, NZ Super eligibility
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Universal from 65; the page says it does not depend on income or assets (the amount is taxable). Residence: citizen or permanent resident; the required years in NZ after age 20 are rising from 10 to 20 for people turning 65 from 1 July 2024 (Fair Residency amendment, phased in by birth year).

gratuity_rule.note: Confirmed absent: Employment New Zealand states an employer does not have to provide redundancy compensation unless it is in the employment agreement or policy; no statutory gratuity or end-of-service payment exists.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Wikipedia, Superannuation in New Zealand; Work and Income NZ Super page
public_pension_scheme.note: NZ Super is the universal, tax-funded flat pension from 65 (no contributions, so no entry ages); it is the same benefit as old_age_allowance_monthly, so do not count it twice. Adjusted yearly with prices and held at 65-66% of the net average wage for a couple; taxable. KiwiSaver is the voluntary contributory savings scheme (lump sum from 65), not a pension. Secondary source for the indexation rule.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit product; KiwiSaver and savings accounts fill this role.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Sold to individuals by New Zealand Debt Management for 6 months to 4 years; interest taxable.

tbill_91d.note: Sold by tender, mainly to institutions.

equity_fund.localNameEn: Managed fund / KiwiSaver fund / index fund
equity_fund.note: Retail index and managed funds (many as PIEs taxed at 10.5-28%) are widely available.

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold.

centralBank.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand – Te Pūtea Matua

insuranceRegulator.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand (insurer prudential supervision); Financial Markets Authority (conduct)

publicHealthCover.name: Health New Zealand – Te Whatu Ora (free public hospital care)

depositInsurance.name: Depositor Compensation Scheme (Reserve Bank of New Zealand)
